final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.translink AS translink, t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM s1 GROUP BY tradekind), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(avgcnt) AS overall FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.tradekind AS tradekind, s2.avgcnt AS avgcnt, s2.avgcnt - s3.overall AS diff FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE s2.avgcnt > s3.overall) SELECT AVG(avgcnt) AS avg_second, AVG(diff) AS avg_third FROM s4
